Who I Am

I'm Akaash Kashyap, a recent graduate from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign with a B.S. in Computer Engineering. My work spans the full systems stack — processor design, operating systems, network programming, embedded drivers, and security.

I care about writing efficient, correct code and building tools that solve real problems. Whether it's a ground-up OS, an out-of-order CPU, or a script that saves a team thousands of hours of manual work, I'm drawn to projects where the engineering actually matters.
